name: DCA Boardwalk Pizza & Pasta Five-Cheese Ravioli or Kids' Turkey Meatball Spaghetti
brandOrRestaurant: Boardwalk Pizza & Pasta (Paradise Gardens Park · Disney California Adventure)
whyItWorks: Soft pillowy cheese ravioli or tender spaghetti with lean turkey meatballs (sauce on the side upon request at the pasta counter) gives you low-residue carbs and protein.
prepOrOrderInstructions: At the pasta counter, ask for spaghetti with turkey meatballs and light/no marinara (or plain butter/Parmesan), or take 1–2 lactase tablets with the Five-Cheese Ravioli.
watchOuts: Ricotta/mozzarella filling in ravioli and pesto cream sauces require lactase enzymes
